title: Side mirror behavior and passenger-side references
summary: This topic mostly contains ambiguous side or passenger-side mentions, while the clear feedback centers on side mirror behavior, mirror-triggered alerts, and a few unrelated passenger-side fit or noise complaints.

positive.summary: Positive feedback is limited and includes appreciation for curb-monitor behavior tied to the passenger-side mirror selection, with examples insufficient for broader themes.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on annoying side-mirror-related behavior such as alerts activating when glancing at mirrors and mirrors folding outward awkwardly, with one unrelated passenger-side door rattle also present in the cluster.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined items are mostly factual or incomplete references to driver-side or passenger-side controls, mirror folding, reflections, and side-location descriptions without clear evaluative sentiment.

signal_notes.interpretation: The exploratory signal indicates that clearly negative or mixed feedback in this topic appears in ICE examples, while the non-ICE examples shown here are predominantly undetermined and do not establish a broader causal difference.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the evidence for clear customer sentiment is limited.
The cluster mixes side-mirror feedback with unrelated passenger-side or side-location references such as door rattle, body fit, charger position, and fuel-filler-side preference.
Some examples are extremely short or incomplete, which limits reliable interpretation of the underlying issue.
